obs: "It is true, that the appraisal and ascertainment of the dutiable value of the goods are made final and conclusive both upon the importer and the government. But the question still remains, what appraisal or ascertainment of the value is to be regarded as final? It is admitted, if the appraisal was infected with fraud or imposition, it could not be, and the collector would not only be justified, but it would be his duty to order reappraisement"
"the decision of the merchant appraisers is final 'provided it is made in pursuance of law;'"
"The decision of the Department is final, but that is on the presupposition that the decision was after a hearing in good faith, however summary in form."
United States Ex Rel. Johnson v. Shaughnessy
